# gov.cn (China Daily) — Green data centers in focus (Dec 9, 2021)

NDRC action plan on data center construction, released Dec 8, 2021 by the NDRC and three other central government departments.

## Key figures
- By 2025: integrated infrastructure pattern with well-distributed green data centers and 5G networks; newly built large and super large data centers nationwide cut PUE down to 1.3.
- Data centers in eastern and western regions to achieve balance in computing power; utilization rate of western data centers to rise from 30% to more than 50%.
- State Grid Energy Research Institute: data center electricity consumption in 2020 estimated to exceed 200 billion kWh (2.7% of national electricity consumption).
- By 2030: data center electricity consumption in China to exceed 400 billion kWh, 3.7% of national total electricity consumption.
- Baidu's 2020 average PUE: 1.14.

## Notes
- Official gov.cn reprint = authoritative. Source of the draft's "200 TWh in 2020 (2.7%) / 400 TWh by 2030 (3.7%)" figures and the PUE 1.3 target.
